account: an entry while flat (allowed): ALLOWED
account: an entry while a position is open: REFUSED
  [position-open] A MNQ position is open (MNQ long 1). Manage it; new entries wait until it is flat. To reduce, use an [exit] order.
account: an [exit] while flat: REFUSED
  [exposure] [exit]/[protect] order but there is no open MNQ position; it would open one. Label entries setup:<name>.
account: an [exit] on the position's side: REFUSED
  [exposure] [exit]/[protect] order is on the same side as the open MNQ position (net 1); it would add exposure.
account: an [exit] larger than the position: REFUSED
  [exposure] [exit]/[protect] size 2 exceeds the open MNQ position (1).
account: an [exit] that reduces it (allowed): ALLOWED
account: a second resting [protect] stop: REFUSED
  [bracket-only] The position (1) already has working stops for 1: a second [protect] stop is a separate order beside its bracket. Modify the bracket's stop/target with modify_order (toward the market only). A [protect] stop goes only when no working stop covers the position (a lost bracket).
account: a [protect] target beside the working stop: REFUSED
  [bracket-only] A [protect] limit is a stand-alone target: no order links it to the stop, so whichever fills first leaves the other working to open a new, unprotected position. Risk is managed with the entry's brackets: modify the bracket's stop/target with modify_order (under a trail or target_then_trail exit the runner manages the exit and wants no target). To take profit or get out now, send an [exit] (market), partial_close_position or close_position.
account: a [protect] stop with no working stop, a lost bracket (allowed): ALLOWED
account: a [protect] stop for the part no stop covers (allowed): ALLOWED
account: a resting limit [exit] beside the working stop: REFUSED
  [bracket-only] A resting [exit] (a limit not through the price now, or a join order) is a stand-alone target: it outlives the stop if the stop fills first. Take profit by trailing the bracket stop with modify_order (toward the market), or close now with a market [exit] (or partial_close_position / close_position). (Limit 21540 would rest: the price now is 21500.)
account: a marketable limit [exit] beside the working stop (allowed): ALLOWED
account: an [exit] with a bracket: REFUSED
  [exposure] [exit]/[protect] orders take no stopLossBracket/takeProfitBracket: their legs could open a new position once the trade is flat. Send the exit or stop alone.
account: two losses from real fills: REFUSED
  [loss-streak] 2 losing closes in a row (from fills). Cooling down for 20 min more.
cancel: the runner cancels the last protective stop: REFUSED
  [cancel-protection] Order 11 is the protective stop for the open MNQ position (net 1). Move it with modify_order, or close the position first ([exit]).
cancel: the runner cancels a target, the stop stays (allowed): ALLOWED
cancel: the model cancels a bracket leg of an open position: REFUSED
  [bracket-leg] Order 12 is a bracket leg (target) of the open MNQ position (net 1): the runner manages the bracket, and it stays while the position is open. Adjust it with modify_order (a stop toward the market only); to get out, send an [exit] or close_position, and the runner cancels the legs once flat.
cancel: the model cancels a leftover on a flat contract (allowed): ALLOWED
modify: a stop moved toward the market (allowed): ALLOWED
modify: a stop moved away from the market: REFUSED
  [modify-protection] Order 11 protects the open MNQ position (net 1); move it toward the market only (now 21480, asked stopPrice 21470). To take more risk, don't; to get out, use an [exit] order.
partial close: within the position (allowed): ALLOWED
partial close: over the position: REFUSED
  [partial-close] partial_close_position size 5 is over the open MNQ position (1); it would reverse it. Close it with close_position, or reduce by at most 1.
partial close: no position: REFUSED
  [partial-close] No open MNQ position to reduce; a partial close would open one.
